coaching.headline: The middle game was a shitshow and the finish was a demolition: both Primal Fangtooths, the Orb Prime and nine structures to four.
coaching.team: The enemy led on kills early, then the team drew level at ten apiece before a 0-4 fight in the enemy half. That fight opened the only stretch where the enemy took structures: three allied outer towers and an inner tower, plus a Fangtooth and a Genesis Core. From the Primal Fangtooth fight on, the team won every fight but one, took both Primal Fangtooths, the Orb Prime and two Genesis Cores, then broke two inhibitors and the Core.

focus.title: One death, then everyone backs off
focus.action: When the first ally drops in a fight in the enemy half, the rest call the retreat and fall back together toward allied towers. Feeding bodies in one at a time is a conga line, not a fight.

21.8.call: Terra killed Grux, Sparrow killed Murdock and Steel, and Lt. Belica killed Gadget. The fight went 0-4 in the enemy half while two allied outer towers fell in the same window, and the enemy added a Fangtooth soon after.

37.3.call: Gadget killed Lt. Belica and Sparrow, Grux killed Countess, Aurora killed Terra and Murdock killed Mourn. The fight went 5-0, the Primal Fangtooth fell to the team in the same window and an enemy inhibitor fell shortly after. That is the template: every enemy dead, then the base.

40.7.call: Grux killed Sparrow, Steel killed Mourn and Murdock killed Lt. Belica with no allied deaths, and the second enemy inhibitor fell in the same window. The enemy Core went down right after. With three enemies dead and an inhibitor open, the whole team commits to the Core.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324 ran the support job properly: the most wards placed in the game, every enemy ward the team destroyed, the most assists in the game and the most damage mitigated on the team. Proper fucking work.

Steel died twice before the ten-minute mark, once to Sparrow outside any detected fight, and the enemy took the first Fangtooth shortly after. Before the next early Fangtooth, Steel waits for Murdock or Aurora before stepping toward the pit.
c2c329a0-75dc-41be-8894-cca296099061: Grux was the best player in this lobby: the most kills, most hero damage and most gold in the game, with hero damage per minute more than double the recorded Grux norm. An absolute fucking menace.
Terra killed Grux three times. Unstoppable Force cleanses debuffs and adds both armors and tenacity, so when Terra slams the helmet down, Grux swaps onto a softer target until that buff ends.
83030cb5-610d-41c6-9fe4-fbbcaaffbe8e: Aurora brought serious jungle damage: the second-most objective damage in the game, hero damage per minute above the recorded Aurora norm, and Countess dead to Aurora twice.

Six deaths is nearly double the recorded Aurora norm, and Countess got three, eating off Aurora like an open buffet. When Countess has not shown on the map, Aurora holds Glacial Charge as the exit, not the opener.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31 led the whole game in objective damage and killed Sparrow three times on Murdock. That is a carry hitting buildings, not just padding a kill count. Keep that shit.

Sparrow also killed Murdock three times. Heightened Senses turns Sparrow invisible and then adds attack speed, so when Sparrow vanishes, Murdock places a Static Trap underfoot and backs toward Steel before trading again.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim ran a clean, rich mid game: the fewest deaths on the team, farm and hero damage per minute well above the recorded Gadget norm, and the second-most gold in the game.

Lt. Belica killed Gadget once and died to Gadget twice. Seismic Assault stuns in a line, so Gadget waits for that stun to be spent, then roots Lt. Belica with Security Gate and drops Tesla Dome on the spot.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.matchup: Steel and Murdock faced carry Sparrow and support Mourn. Sparrow stacks Relentless with basic attacks and abilities and vanishes with Heightened Senses; Mourn pulls with Abduct, mesmerizes with Beguile, heals allies with Contagion and was the enemy's listed healer. The allied duo died three times before the ten-minute mark and the enemy duo did not die, with Sparrow killing Steel twice in that stretch. Across the match Countess was the top enemy damage dealer, dealing magical damage.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Xenia shields a nearby ally, Tainted Guard punishes enemy basic attacks with healing reduction and a bleed, Dynamo makes immobilized enemies take more damage after Shield Bash or Shield Slam, Gaia Greaves stores movement for a bonus hit, and Flux Matrix makes nearby enemy heroes take more magical damage and lowers enemy tenacity. Flux Matrix suits a team where Gadget, Aurora and Steel all deal magical damage. Every completed item adds armor, which also feeds Heavy Metal.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Krix adds maximum health. Voracity restores a little health and gold on unit kills, while Cannibalism permanently adds health on takedowns and suits the highest assist count in the game. Regenerative Tissue is the alternative first minor, regenerating health after a stretch without hero damage, trading kill sustain for recovery between fights. Festering Wounds adds anti-heal on immobilizes, but four allies already carried an anti-heal item, so that slot is not needed here.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.augment: Heavy Metal adds magical on-hit damage to heavy punches and Shield Bash based on total physical and magical armor, and every completed item added armor, so the augment scaled with this inventory. Adaptive Force is the alternative when blocking Sparrow's shots matters more: Force Shield gets two charges and a shorter cooldown at a smaller size. Colossal Crash widens Shield Slam's range and area and makes the impact a knock back instead, which suits peeling more than holding enemies in place.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.crest: Rift Walkers dashes and pulls nearby heroes, raises the ward cap and pays passive gold while minion gold diminishes. The pull sets up Shield Bash and Shield Slam, and the larger ward cap fits the most wards placed in the game. Activations and heroes pulled are not recorded.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.improvement: The winning core is Fire Blossom, Raiment of Renewal and Tainted Charm, none of which Steel built. Tainted Charm's proximity anti-heal would cover Countess and Mourn, the two biggest enemy healers, but four allies already carried anti-heal. Raiment of Renewal adds health and tenacity against Beguile and Seismic Assault, at the cost of Flux Matrix's magical armor and damage amplification. With the most mitigation on the team, the current armor stack is a sound keep.

c2c329a0-75dc-41be-8894-cca296099061.matchup: Grux's offlane opponent was Terra. Terra's Tainted Guard cuts healing on any hero basic-attacking Terra, which hits Savage Strikes, Lust For Blood, Sky Splitter and Mutilator sustain, and Frostguard lowers the attack speed of heroes hitting Terra. Unstoppable Force cleanses, adds armor and tenacity and disables nearby towers. Terra killed Grux three times and Grux killed Terra twice. Countess also killed Grux twice.
c2c329a0-75dc-41be-8894-cca296099061.build: Sky Splitter adds current-health damage and lifesteal on basic attacks, and Double Pain applies on-hit effects twice. Basilisk shreds physical armor on hero damage, which matters against Terra's armor stack, and Mutilator adds maximum-health damage on attacks and ability hits. Augmentation empowers the next basic attack after each cast. Void Helm adds magical armor against Countess, Lt. Belica and Mourn and boosts all healing, and Grux had the most healing on the team.
c2c329a0-75dc-41be-8894-cca296099061.eternal: Thraex marks the last hero Grux basic-attacked, adding damage against that target and reducing that target's damage to Grux. Savage Strikes adds ramping on-hit damage that heals, and Ferocity grows attack speed the longer hero combat lasts. That suits a long brawler, and Grux took the most damage of any ally. Golden Mane is the second-minor alternative, cutting damage from non-area attacks and abilities, trading the attack speed ramp for durability against Sparrow's basic attacks and Feast.
c2c329a0-75dc-41be-8894-cca296099061.augment: Lust For Blood heals Grux for part of the damage dealt to enemies carrying maximum Bloodlust stacks, which rewards staying on one target. Terra's Tainted Guard cuts that healing whenever Grux basic-attacks Terra, so the augment pays best on targets without that item. Red Mist is the alternative, adding attack speed for each nearby enemy hero or camp leader with Bloodlust, trading sustain for faster stacking.
c2c329a0-75dc-41be-8894-cca296099061.crest: Iceskorn Talons creates an ice sheet that gives allies on the sheet physical power and movement speed and slows enemies on the sheet. Grux and Murdock both deal physical damage, so the buff has two allied users, and the slow helps Grux stick to a target. Activations are not recorded.
c2c329a0-75dc-41be-8894-cca296099061.improvement: The winning core is Sky Splitter, Rapture and Augmentation; Grux skipped only Rapture. Rapture adds attack speed, health, omnivamp and close-range on-hit damage, but taking Rapture costs a slot such as Basilisk's armor shred against Terra or Void Helm's magical armor against three magical damage dealers. With the most kills and hero damage in the game, the current build is a sound keep; Rapture is the comparison only when the magical threats matter less.

83030cb5-610d-41c6-9fe4-fbbcaaffbe8e.matchup: Aurora's jungle opponent was Countess, the top enemy damage dealer and the biggest healer in the game. Blade Siphon heals per target hit with extra healing against heroes, Shadow Slip dashes and can swap back, and Feast leaps, suppresses and heals off Haemorrhage. Countess killed Aurora three times, including first blood, and Aurora killed Countess twice. Sparrow also killed Aurora twice.
83030cb5-610d-41c6-9fe4-fbbcaaffbe8e.build: Magnify shreds magical armor on ability hits and adds omnivamp. Spectral Schematics adds current-health damage on immobilizing, which Hoarfrost, Cryoseism and Glacial Thorns all trigger. World Breaker ramps magical damage on heroes and adds tenacity, Tainted Scepter cuts healing on magical damage with Countess and Mourn as targets, and Elafrost adds physical armor and a slowing empowered attack. Prophecy adds on-hit magical damage. No completed item adds magical armor, against three magical damage dealers.
83030cb5-610d-41c6-9fe4-fbbcaaffbe8e.eternal: Idrisil adds both armors while above a health threshold and turns that bonus into a shield when health drops low. Frost Snap adds damage against slowed or immobilized targets, which Boreal Sweep, Hoarfrost and Cryoseism supply, and Icy Touch slows enemy attack speed on basic attacks. Glacier is the second-minor alternative, permanently adding magical armor from gold earned, which answers the missing magical armor against Countess at the cost of the attack-speed slow on Sparrow.
83030cb5-610d-41c6-9fe4-fbbcaaffbe8e.augment: Glacial Thorns makes Glacial Charge leave crystals that damage and root, adding a trigger for Spectral Schematics, Frost Snap and the passive's cooldown reduction on immobilizing heroes. Hypothermia is the alternative, making Boreal Sweep shred both armors and slow attack speed, trading a root for a debuff that helps the whole team's damage. Root hits are not recorded.
83030cb5-610d-41c6-9fe4-fbbcaaffbe8e.crest: Winter's Fury releases an expanding sphere that damages, slows and makes damaged enemies take more magical damage. Gadget, Steel and Aurora all deal magical damage, so the amplification had allied users. Activations are not recorded.
83030cb5-610d-41c6-9fe4-fbbcaaffbe8e.improvement: The winning core is Spirit Of Amir, Magnify and Spectral Schematics; Aurora skipped only Spirit Of Amir. The bigger gap is the flag for no magical armor against a three-magical enemy team led by Countess. Swapping Prophecy for Vainglory adds both armors that grow during hero combat, giving up on-hit damage. With deaths nearly double the recorded Aurora norm, that swap is the comparison whenever Countess is the top enemy damage dealer.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.matchup: Murdock and Steel faced carry Sparrow and support Mourn. Sparrow vanishes and gains attack speed with Heightened Senses and charges Piercing Shot through units and terrain, while Mourn's Abduct pulls the first target hit. Sparrow and Murdock killed each other three times apiece. Across the match Countess killed Murdock twice, and Terra stacked physical armor through Frostguard, Tainted Guard, Elafrost and Vainglory, with Tainted Guard cutting healing on any hero basic-attacking Terra.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Imperator raises critical damage and Vanquisher executes heroes at very low health. Tainted Rounds cuts healing on basic attacks, with Countess and Mourn as the top enemy healers, and adds on-hit damage that grows as the target's health falls. Onixian Quiver fires extra projectiles on each ranged basic attack, and Demolisher ignores part of physical armor, which suits Terra's armor stack. This build came with the most objective damage in the game.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: Vermis adds maximum-health damage on every third consecutive basic attack on the same hero, and Serration adds missing-health damage to that proc. Melting Point only pays against very heavily armored targets; Terra is the one enemy with an armor stack that could reach that threshold, and whether that happened is not recorded. Sub-Surface is the alternative, cutting damage from area abilities such as Hail of Arrows and Blade Siphon.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.augment: Justice's Reach makes Shots Fired pierce units and adds range, so the charged shot reaches past minions and frontliners. Martial Law is the alternative, boosting Long Arm of the Law and adding gold on hero kills, trading basic-attack reach for ultimate damage. Charged-shot hits are not recorded.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.crest: Pacifier dashes, empowers the next physical damage instance, hits harder against low-health targets and can be recast after a hero kill. Murdock's basic attacks and Buckshot deal physical damage, so the empowered hit has natural targets, and Hot Pursuit's reset on takedown pairs with the recast. Activations are not recorded.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.improvement: The winning core is Lightning Hawk, Vanquisher and Imperator; Murdock skipped only Lightning Hawk. Lightning Hawk builds momentum while moving or attacking and slows with the empowered hit, which helps kite Countess, at the cost of Onixian Quiver's extra projectiles. Sparrow and Countess accounted for all five Murdock deaths, so a defensive slot is also a fair comparison; otherwise the current build is a sound keep.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.matchup: Gadget's mid opponent was Lt. Belica, built around basic-attack and critical items plus Wraith Leggings and Oathkeeper. Seismic Assault stuns in a line, Void Drone drains mana and Neural Disruptor deals bonus damage based on the target's missing mana, so Gadget's mana pool is a direct target. Lt. Belica killed Gadget once and Gadget killed Lt. Belica twice. Countess and Terra each killed Gadget once.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Soulbinder adds damage on long-range ability hits, Azure Core adds mana and a low-health shield, Oblivion Crown multiplies magical power, Combustion adds bonus area damage on ability hits, and Tainted Scepter cuts healing on magical damage against Countess and Mourn. Seek and Destroy and Tesla Dome both deal damage over time across an area, which suits Combustion and Tainted Scepter.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Aion grants mana regeneration on spell casts and gold from spell damage to heroes. Bottomless Vial restores a potion charge and adds permanent magical power on each river buff Gadget kills, though river buff credit is not recorded per player. Runic Focus adds magical power based on current mana, which Lt. Belica's Void Drone attacks directly. Arcane Resonance is the alternative second minor, speeding basic cooldowns from mana regeneration instead of relying on a full mana bar.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.augment: Auto-Lock Amp speeds Seek and Destroy's homing, keeping the drone's damage and slow on a moving target. Blast Zone is the alternative, widening Sticky Mine's explosion and adding FDA stacks on enhanced mines on heroes, trading drone tracking for faster magical power growth. Drone hits are not recorded.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.crest: Soulbearer grants a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed for a short window, which pays most while Tesla Dome and Seek and Destroy are hitting heroes. Gadget had the fewest deaths on the team, so the defensive need was modest here. Activations are not recorded.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.improvement: The winning core is Azure Core, Entropy and Overseer; Gadget had Azure Core but not the other two. Overseer makes Tesla Dome hit harder and heals Gadget for part of that damage, at the cost of Soulbinder's long-range bonus. With deaths below and farm and damage above the recorded Gadget norms, the current build is a sound keep.

threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~1.8s of lockdown): Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s), Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s), Mourn Abduct (pull). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Mourn. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 4 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Countess. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s), Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
ourKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
ourKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
ourKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
ourKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
ourKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
ourKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

enemyKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
enemyKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Shadow Slip in → Eventide → Blade Siphon → Feast suppress ult, Haemorrhage true-damage
enemyKits.winCondition: Feast-suppress a squishy and delete them with true-damage burst
enemyKits.passive: two-ability hits apply a %max-HP true-damage bleed
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
enemyKits.playAgainst: Feast is her whole engage — bait it / peel; she's fragile, punish the recast window

enemyKits.combo: Wild Rush charge → Ruthless Assault → Highland Hurl slow → Unstoppable Force cleanse ult
enemyKits.winCondition: engage Unstoppable and grind with Hersir-empowered swings
enemyKits.passive: Hersir stacks empower the next basic
enemyKits.playAgainst: save CC for after Unstoppable Force; kite her charge

enemyKits.combo: Abduct pull → Contagion ally-heal bugs → Beguile damage-reduction → Eclipse vision-denial ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and sustain the team through the brawl
enemyKits.playWith: burst that punishes his pulled target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect the long Abduct channel/range; anti-heal blunts Contagion
